CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financeiropro_operacoes.competencia_v1(p_data text, p_forma text, p_fatura text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN p_forma='Cartão de Crédito' AND p_fatura ~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])/20[0-9]{2}$'
 THEN right(p_fatura,4)||'-'||left(p_fatura,2)
 ELSE left(p_data,7) END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financeiropro_operacoes.protect_password_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.senha ~ '^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$' THEN
  NEW.senha='bcrypt-sha256$'||extensions.crypt(lower(NEW.senha),extensions.gen_salt('bf',12));
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financeiropro_operacoes.require_access(p_usuario bigint, p_modulo text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE a jsonb;BEGIN
 a=public.fp_access_v1(p_usuario,p_modulo);
 IF NOT coalesce((a->>'allowed')::boolean,false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE=a->>'message'; END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION financeiropro_operacoes.validate_customer_account()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.conta_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.contas c WHERE c.id=NEW.conta_id AND c.usuario_id=NEW.usuario_id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='A conta bancária deve pertencer ao mesmo usuário do cliente';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fp_financeiro_v1(p_usuario bigint, p_tabela text, p_acao text, p_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_dados jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_versao text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_chave uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT public.fp_financeiro_modulo_v1(p_usuario,p_tabela,p_acao,p_id,p_dados,p_versao,p_chave,NULL)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fp_tv_habilitado_v1(p_usuario bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM financeiropro_operacoes.tv_integration_owner WHERE usuario_id=p_usuario);
$function$
